data.title: Business Development Executive Internship
data.details:
Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Identify and generate new business opportunities.
  • Find potential clients and connect with them.
  • Handle client inquiries through calls, emails, and meetings.
  • Explain company products and services to customers.
  • Build and maintain good relationships with clients.
  • Follow up with potential customers and convert leads into business.
  • Achieve monthly sales and business development targets.

Requirements:

  • Qualification: Graduate / Undergraduate.
  • Good communication and convincing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office.
  • Confidence in handling clients and making calls.
  • Good negotiation and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team.
  • Freshers can apply; sales or business development experience is a plus.

Key Skills:

  • Communication Skills
  • Lead Generation
  • Client Handling
  • Negotiation Skills
  • Problem-Solving
  • Relationship Management

data.title: Business Development Internship
data.details:
Ideovent Technologies is hiring for Business Development Intern

About the Company

Ideovent Technologies is a web design, custom software, and digital solutions studio serving businesses in India and internationally. The team builds websites and web applications that help organizations strengthen their online presence and support their operations. This remote Business Development Intern opportunity offers practical exposure to client outreach and growth activities across the IT services industry.

Responsibilities

  • Research prospective B2B clients, including businesses in hospitality, healthcare, education, personal care, fitness, and retail.
  • Reach out to potential clients through calls, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Instagram, email, and other suitable channels.
  • Understand prospects’ needs and introduce relevant website development, software, and digital services.
  • Coordinate discovery conversations and meetings with interested prospects and the sales or technical team.
  • Maintain lead records, track outreach, and follow up with contacts in an organized manner.
  • Support early client communications and onboarding coordination.

Requirements

  • Applicants should have 0 years of prior experience; motivated candidates interested in learning business development are welcome.
  • Strong Hindi and English communication skills, with an interest in sales, marketing, and client handling.
  • Basic familiarity with websites, software, and digital services; experience with LinkedIn, Instagram, WhatsApp Business, or Google Maps is useful.
  • Good research, organization, and follow-up habits, along with self-motivation and discipline.

This is a three-month, unpaid remote internship with flexible hours. Interns can develop communication, sales, negotiation, and client-handling skills through real-world B2B work and receive mentorship. A certificate is offered on successful completion, and a letter of recommendation may be available for outstanding performance. High-performing interns may be considered for future paid roles.

data.title: Sales Internship
data.details:
About the Company

ByteBix Technologies operates in the Information Technology industry and is seeking a Sales Intern to support customer outreach and business growth from its Darbhanga, Bihar location. The internship offers an opportunity to learn practical sales fundamentals while contributing to the company's efforts to introduce technology products and services to prospective customers.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and research prospective customers, businesses, and relevant market opportunities.
  • Assist with outreach, follow-ups, and maintaining clear records of sales conversations and leads.
  • Understand the company's offerings and communicate their value to prospective customers in a professional manner.
  • Work with colleagues to support sales activities, share customer feedback, and track progress against assigned tasks.
  • Help prepare basic updates on lead status, customer needs, and market observations.

Requirements

  • Applicants may be freshers or have up to two years of relevant experience.
  • Clear communication, a customer-focused approach, organization, and willingness to learn are important.
  • Interest in sales and the Information Technology industry is desirable; the ability to use common digital tools for communication and record-keeping will be useful.
  • This is a two-month, full-time, in-office internship based in Darbhanga, Bihar, with a monthly stipend of ₹6,000–₹8,000.
